display.purpose: Wordmark, cover heading and chapter titles; Archivo with tight tracking and balanced wrapping.

body.purpose: Method notes, explanations and limitations; Source Sans 3 at 16px/1.55.

data.purpose: Dates, product ids, coordinates, blend readout and provenance stamps; monospace with tabular figures only.

shadows.name: marker-pin
shadows.purpose: Single soft ambient shadow under map evidence markers so they read as instrument pins. No other surface lifts.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (chips, buttons, blend).

motion.name: duration-camera
motion.purpose: Presentation camera moves between chapters; skipped entirely under reduced motion or the Skip animations toggle.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main progression action (Explore the story, Next).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #16232e; color: #f4f4f2; border: none; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 600 14px/1.4 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #101820; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #101820; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions and mode toggles (Guided mode, Skip animations, Previous).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #fbfbfa; color: #16232e; border: 1px solid #d4d7d3; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font: 600 14px/1.4 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #e2e6e2; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #101820; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #16232e; color: #f4f4f2; border-color: #16232e; }

components.name: Layer Chip
components.description: Toggles a thematic map class; swatch carries color plus hatch or outline.
components.css: .ds-chip-layer { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #fbfbfa; color: #16232e; border: 1px solid #d4d7d3; border-radius: 3px; padding: 6px 10px; font: 600 14px/1.4 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-chip-layer:hover { background: #e2e6e2; } .ds-chip-layer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #101820; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-layer[aria-pressed="false"] { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-swatch { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #d4d7d3; flex: none; } .ds-swatch-newwater { background: #0e8f9a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #064a52; }

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: Record sheet for one evidence point: observed, interpretation, method, limitations, sources.
components.html:
1 Edge of the water sheet

What is observed
Backscatter change consistent with new water relative to the reference.
Interpretation
Possible new water: candidate + change, outside the reference channel.
components.css: .ds-card-evidence { background: #fbfbfa; color: #16232e; border: 1px solid #d4d7d3; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; max-width: 380px; font: 400 14px/1.55 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-evidence.ds-selected { border: 2px solid #101820; } .ds-card-evidence h3 { margin: 0 0 12px; font: 700 16px/1.3 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-card-evidence dl { margin: 0; } .ds-card-evidence dt { font-weight: 600; margin-top: 10px; } .ds-card-evidence dd { margin: 2px 0 0; color: #46586a; }

components.name: Synthetic Stamp
components.description: Provenance stamp on every surface rendering demonstration data. No icons, dots or arrows.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; width: fit-content; background: #fbfbfa; color: #a06a00; border: 1px solid #a06a00; border-radius: 3px; padding: 2px 8px; font: 600 12px/1.5 ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Legend
components.description: Class legend: color plus hatch/outline/label; identical values to the map masks.
components.html:
• Reference water
  • Possible new water
  • Ambiguous area
  • Not evaluated
  • Selection
components.css: .ds-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 16px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-legend li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font: 400 12px/1.4 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #46586a; } .ds-swatch { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid #d4d7d3; flex: none; } .ds-swatch-reference { background: #1f5fa6; } .ds-swatch-newwater { background: #0e8f9a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #064a52; } .ds-swatch-ambiguous { background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(160 106 0 / 0.55) 0 2px, transparent 2px 6px), rgb(160 106 0 / 0.2); } .ds-swatch-noteval { background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgb(107 114 128 / 0.5) 0 2px, transparent 2px 6px), rgb(107 114 128 / 0.2); } .ds-swatch-selection { background: #fbfbfa; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #101820; }

narrative.overview:
FloodLens reads like a field survey document that happens to be interactive: neutral paper grounds, hairline rules, tabular data stamps, and a map whose colors are a legend first and a picture second. Every surface behaves like a record sheet — observation dates, method notes and limitations sit next to the thing they describe, never behind it. The 3D territory is an instrument panel, not a spectacle: flat thematic masks over exaggerated relief, no waves, no simulated water advance.

Density is calm and operable. One column carries the viewer, one carries the chapter record; the chrome (top bar, legend bar) stays fixed while records scroll. Expression lives in precision — hatches, outlines, monospace stamps — not in ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral cool paper ground; panels a half-step lighter; hairline borders instead of shadows.
Class colors are semantic and constant across map, legend, chips and exercises.
Color is never the only identifier: hatches, outlines and labels accompany every class.
Near-square corners (8/4/3/2 px); sentence case everywhere; monospace only for real data.
Synthetic provenance is stamped on every surface that shows demonstration data.

rules.name: The Legend Contract Rule
rules.body: A class color on the map must be the same value as its legend swatch and its exercise chip. If a mask renders washed out, the render order is wrong — fix the pipeline, never the legend.

rules.name: The Two-Identifier Rule
rules.body: Every thematic class carries color plus a second identifier (hatch, outline or label). Removing color must leave the map readable.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, nav, buttons and labels use sentence case. Title Case is a defect, not a style.

rules.name: The Real Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for values a sensor or a file produced. Never set prose in monospace for atmosphere.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: Panels and cards never lift. If something needs emphasis, use the selection outline or a state color, not a shadow.

dos: Do keep observation dates visible wherever an observation is shown (data font, tabular figures).
Do stamp synthetic provenance on every surface that renders demonstration data.
Do pair every class color with a hatch, outline or label.
Do use sentence case and the 8/4/3/2 px radius scale on product surfaces.
Do let the journey work fully without WebGL: text alternative and HTML exercises carry the learning.
donts: Don't render a thematic mask under an observation texture; the legend contract outranks the render stack.
Don't add taglines, helper text or secondary labels the layout should carry.
Don't invent chrome on pills and stamps (no dots, arrows, icons or mono prose).
Don't use shadows, gradients or dramatized motion to suggest water advance or depth.
Don't present synthetic or unverified data without its label; NISAR pending is stated, never silently substituted.
